Sold Out, Waitlist Closed The is sold out, and waitlisting is closed. The 's = "0", and the = "0". FAQ Q: What is the difference between the ’s and fields? A: When you create an , the field is set to “Active” (the default value). The field tracks the internal status of the . The values “Draft”, “Active”, “Canceled”, and “Completed” are assigned dynamically. The default value can only be changed via automation. The tracks the current status of your , which is calculated based on capacity values and the publish/unpublish status. You can review the definition of each value here .   Q: Do I have to set the and fields on both the and records? A: No, the and fields do not need to be set on both the and records. Q: What happens if the start dates on the and are different? A: If you add the and on the page and the current date is after the , then the banner on the home page will say “Completed”.  If you add the and on the page, a different and on the , and the current date is after the , then the banner on the home page will say “Completed” and the text next to the will say “Sale ended [Day, mm/dd/yyyy].”  Q: What happens when an 's = “Canceled”? Will a Canceled banner appear? A: No, a Canceled banner will not appear when an 's = "Canceled." Instead, an Error 2004 will occur if the 's is not set to “Active” or “Draft.”
